title: Homology-zero cochain maps in a split abelian category are null homotopic
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every object is projective (every map from it lifts across an epimorphism) and injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let K and L be arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes in C, meaning objects K^i and L^i with degree-one differentials whose consecutive composites vanish. A cochain map f:K→L inducing the zero map on H^q=ker(d^q)/im(d^(q-1)) for every integer q admits a degree-minus-one homotopy A with f=d_K A+A d_L. No boundedness or concentration of homology is assumed.

proof.text: Choose r_i:K^i→Z_K^i retracting the cycles inclusion by Injective.factorThru. The homology-zero condition and homology naturality show cyclesMap(f)_i≫π_L=0. The exact sequence L^(i-1)→Z_L^i→H_L^i, obtained from homologyIsCokernel, lets ShortComplex.Exact.liftFromProjective lift cyclesMap(f)_i to t_i:Z_K^i→L^(i-1). Consequently t_i≫d_L=i_K≫f_i.

Set A_i=r_i≫t_i and let T=d_K A+A d_L, the chain map Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'. The nullHomotopy' constructor proves T null homotopic. Restricting T to cycles kills the first summand and uses i_K≫r_i=id in the second, so i_K≫T_i=i_K≫f_i. Hence g=f-T kills cycles. Commutation with differentials gives g_i≫d_L=d_K≫g_(i+1)=0, because d_K factors through cycles.

Inclusion_K≫(id-r_i≫inclusion_K)=0. The exact sequence Z_K^i→K^i→K^(i+1), obtained from cyclesIsKernel, and injectivity give u_i:K^(i+1)→K^i with d_K≫u_i=id-r_i≫inclusion_K, by ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective. Put B_i=u_(i-1)≫g_(i-1). Then d_K B=g because g kills cycles; B d_L=0 because g has image in cycles. Thus Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'(B)=g and nullHomotopy'(B) contracts g. Add this to the homotopy of T; the equality f=T+g completes the proof.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_nullHomotopy_of_homologyMap_zero
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C]
    [∀ X : C, Projective X] [∀ X : C, Injective X]
    {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (hf : ∀ q : ℤ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f q = 0) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy f 0)
